caption:
how long does it take to repair your skin barrier?

In a lab study, researchers tape-stripped the outer skin layer on forearms and watched it rebuild for 10 days. Repair activity peaked on day 3, and the layer grew back about 2.3 micrometers a day.

That was one clean injury. A face gets hit again every day by cleansers, actives and weather, so real recovery usually takes longer.

Give it at least two weeks of gentle care before you judge, and see a dermatologist if nothing changes.

Save this for the next time your skin stings.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Bargo et al., Exp Dermatol 2013 (all authors worked for a consumer products company)
Rajkumar et al., Skin Pharmacol Physiol 2023 (review)
